nodes.name: Call Gemini generateContent
nodes.notes: ASSUMPTION (no live API access to verify): model id 'gemini-2.0-flash' on the v1beta generateContent endpoint, structured output via generationConfig.responseMimeType='application/json' + responseSchema=the caller's response_schema (Gemini's native JSON-mode/schema-constrained generation, not prose parsed after the fact). Auth is an HTTP Header Auth credential ('Gemini API', placeholder id REPLACE_WITH_GEMINI_API_CREDENTIAL_ID) whose stored header is expected to be 'x-goog-api-key: <API key>' -- set this up in n8n's credential UI on import, matching how gmail-ingestion.json/email-normaliser.json reference not-yet-created credentials by placeholder id + real name. options.response.response.neverError=true (plus onError=continueRegularOutput for network-level failures) means a non-2xx status lands here as a normal item instead of throwing, so 'Parse Gemini response' can inspect statusCode/body and always produce a typed { success, ... } result.
